verdict.rationale: Gide documents a dedicated Intellectual Property practice that it calls 'one of the largest and most recognised in the French market', and that practice explicitly covers trademarks. Brand enforcement is well evidenced: the firm cites in-depth expertise in trade mark and design disputes before French and EU courts and offices, plus cross-border trademark litigation. Missing for 10: explicit mention of trademark clearance/searches, explicit mention of registration/prosecution filing services, and independent corroboration such as rankings for the trademark practice.
